title: 大学课堂该不该录像
summary_zh: 很多大学把课堂录下来放到网上。作者觉得这对复习、对生病和母语不是英语的学生都很有用，但录像不能代替去上课。读完你能用 although 和 not… but… 写一段有正反两面的观点文。
body: At many universities, lectures are now recorded and put online after class. Some lecturers worry that students will stop coming, but I believe that recording every lecture is a good idea. The first reason is revision. Even the best students miss things during a fast lecture, and a recording lets them go back and check. This is especially helpful for students who are studying in a second language, as they can slow down a difficult part or listen again. Second, life does not always follow the timetable. Students get ill, have family problems or need to work, and a recording means they do not fall behind. Although some students may choose to stay at home, research on whether recordings really empty lecture halls has not given a clear answer. Many students say they use recordings as well as going to class, not instead of it. Of course, a recording cannot replace everything. You cannot ask a question, join a discussion or meet other students through a screen. So universities should record lectures, but they should also make the classroom a place worth coming to. Then the recording becomes a safety net, not the main event.

questions.prompt: What is the writer's main opinion?
options: Lectures should be recorded, but going to class still matters
Students should only watch lectures online
Recordings are only useful for lecturers
questions.evidence: So universities should record lectures, but they should also make the classroom a place worth coming to.

questions.prompt: What does the writer mean by calling a recording "a safety net"?
options: It is a way to check attendance
It is something to help you when you cannot be there or missed something
It is the most important part of the course
It stops students from failing exams
questions.evidence: Then the recording becomes a safety net, not the main event.

questions.prompt: What does "fall behind" mean in "they do not fall behind"?
options: not keep up with the work

questions.prompt: What does the writer say you cannot do through a screen?
options: Ask a question or join a discussion
questions.evidence: You cannot ask a question, join a discussion or meet other students through a screen.

vocabulary.example: Our lectures start at nine every morning.
I need to do some revision for the test.
Check the timetable for the next class.
Nothing can replace a good teacher.
We had a long discussion about the book.

expressions.note: Can you slow down a little?
If you miss a week, it is easy to fall behind.
She speaks French as well as English.
be worth + -ing 值得做：The film is worth watching.
比喻出问题时能接住你的东西。

knowledge.quote: Although some students may choose to stay at home, research on whether recordings really empty lecture halls has not given a clear answer.
knowledge.explanation: Although 引导让步状语从句，先承认反方观点，再说明证据并不明确。

knowledge.quote: So universities should record lectures, but they should also make the classroom a place worth coming to.
knowledge.explanation: should 表示建议；but… also… 说明两件事都要做。

knowledge.quote: I believe that recording every lecture is a good idea
knowledge.explanation: 动名词短语 recording every lecture 在宾语从句里作主语，谓语用单数 is。

speaking: 用 1 分钟说说：你觉得课堂录像好不好？你会因为有录像就不去上课吗？用上 although 和 as well as。
writing: 用 80–100 词写一段观点文：学校该不该把课堂录下来？先说一个好处，再说一个问题。用一个 Although… 句子。

task.prompt: 仿照这句，用 … becomes a safety net, not the main event 写一句话，说说一样东西的辅助作用。
task.model: Then the recording becomes a safety net, not the main event.
